subject: maths
question: A certain sum amounts to ₹ 11,520 in 4 years at the rate of 15% p.a. simple interest. what will be the amount of the same sum in 2 years at the same rate, if the interest is compounded 8-monthly (nearest to a ₹)?
solution:
**Given:**

Amount = ₹ 11,520 

T = 4 years, R = 15% p.a. simple interest

**Concept Used:**

SI = (P × R × T)/100

Where, P is principal, r is rate of interest 

If p be the principal, r be the rate of interest then the interest compounded 8 monthly then compound interest will be P x [(1 + r/100)³ - 1]

**Calculation:**

SI = PRT/100

= P x 15 x (4/100)

= 3P/5

Amount = P + SI

⇒ 11520 = P + 3P/5

⇒ P = 7200

Time = 3years (compounded 8 monthly)

Rate = 15/12 x 8 = 10%

CI = P x [(1 + r/100)3 - 1]

= 7200 x [(1 + 10/100)3 - 1]

= 2383

Amount = 7200 + 2383

= 9583

**Therefore, the amount of the same sum in 2 years at the same rate, if the interest is compounded 8-monthly is ₹9583**
